summary: Optional clipboard text encryption and safer portable backup.

changes.title: Clipboard text vault
changes.detail: Opt in to per-record device-bound AES-GCM encryption; migrate saved text and image references without removing pins. Image bytes are not encrypted yet.

changes.title: Safer clipboard backup
changes.detail: Clipboard text export is explicit and plaintext; validated imports merge instead of clearing current history. Images are excluded.

changes.title: Database cleanup status
changes.detail: Retry SQLite cleanup separately; no guarantee of forensic erasure.

changes.title: Additional Return variants
changes.detail: Tint multiline shifted Return and explicit navigation/inline Done actions; include shifted Return in shared-key morphs.

changes.title: Optional editing gestures
changes.detail: Enable a dedicated Edit key for letter-slide shortcuts or configurable directional flicks; off by default and separate from normal glide typing.

changes.title: Clipboard migration compatibility
changes.detail: Read and verify SQLite secure-delete PRAGMA through the result-returning query API before converting existing records.
